notes:
A small follow-up for two-tablet setups.

**Panel wake can now switch itself back on.** Panel wake is the setting that stops a page ghosting when it is turned from the other tablet. On some Boox tablets, closing Obbligato from the multitasking screen switches it off. A tablet can now be given permission to change that setting, and Obbligato then turns panel wake back on by itself whenever it opens. That permission can only be given from a computer, so on every other tablet nothing changes: while two tablets are paired and panel wake is off, you are still asked to turn it on.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
